info.title: Ranjit API
info.description: Self-hosted financial data API with SQLite or PostgreSQL, statement imports, a local sandbox and direct bank adapters. Includes idempotent connection creation and signed sync webhooks. Bank access requires operator-issued credentials; bank connectors remain experimental.

post.summary: Create a connection using the configured authorization mode
post.description: With Idempotency-Key, retries within 24 hours return the same connection in its current state (201). Reusing a key with different customer_id or institution_id returns 409. After 24 hours the key may create a new connection. Sandbox authorization_url is returned only while the original link is pending and unexpired. Requests without the header create a connection each time. The key is scoped to the installation; use a random key per operation and persist it in your backend.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Random operation key, reused for retries of the same request for 24 hours. No spaces.

post.summary: Receive a terminal sync result at RANJIT_WEBHOOK_URL
post.description: Configure a shared signing secret, at least 32 characters. Ranjit-Signature is t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + dot + original body>. Verify before JSON decoding and enforce a five-minute timestamp tolerance. Deduplicate event.id durably. Retries keep the same ID/body with a fresh signature. Delivery is unordered and may repeat. Eight automatic attempts, ten-second timeout, redirects rejected. Events contain metadata only.
